description: The line plot illustrates the loss ratio as a function of TFLOPS for different configurations of SepLLM. The x-axis, labeled "TFLOPS," is on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^4 to 10^9. The y-axis, labeled "Loss Ratio (%)," ranges from 94% to 100%.
